name: Label
description: Form field label atom. Renders a native <label> in body-md type, bound to a control via the for prop.

props.name: for
props.description: id of the form control this label describes (native label/for association).

notes: Always pair with a form control via the for attribute so clicking the label focuses the control.
Do not use Label for non-form headings — it renders a native <label> element.
